title: Inclusion and quotient-map normalization of the concrete homology couple
statement: For an abelian category C [def-sp-abelian], a cochain complex K with decreasing filtration F [def-sp-filtration] and its graded quotients [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], let X be the concrete filtered homology exact couple [def-sp-filtered-homology-exact-couple]. There exist comparisons eD(P,Q):X.D(P,Q) isomorphic to H^(P+Q)(F^(-Q)K) identifying alpha with homology of the filtration inclusion and initialG, followed by the reindexing equality and filteredHomologyEIso, with homology of the graded quotient projection. All integer transports and equations are exactly those in the Lean statement. This asserts no quotient-page or spectral-sequence differential comparison.

source.place: Tags 012K and 011Q; the shifted differential-object construction of Tag 0AMK, alpha induced by inclusion and g induced by quotient

proof.text: Unfold the concrete homology couple of the existing definition. Its D terms are filteredHomologyD, so take eD to be identity isomorphisms. The alpha equation is exactly the definition filteredHomologyAlpha, with proof-irrelevant index equality transports.

Unfold initialG and the explicit filteredHomologyG. The base E isomorphism is an equality isomorphism. Associate the composition to cancel the integer equality morphisms: 2(-Q)+(P+2Q)=P, -(-Q)=Q, and -Q+(P+2Q)=P+Q. The remaining map is homology of the quotient projection. This construction also applies to zero and constant filtrations, without finiteness.

proof_origin.note: Only the concrete inclusion/projection normalization of the initial couple; the target theorem combines this with existing first-connecting and all-page quotient comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredHomologyCouple_normalization
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) :
    ∃ (eD : ∀ P Q : ℤ, (filteredHomologyExactCouple K F).D P Q ≅
        (F.step (-Q) : CochainComplex C ℤ).homology (P + Q)),
      (∀ P Q : ℤ,
        (filteredHomologyExactCouple K F).alpha P Q ≫
            (eD (P - 1) (Q + 1)).hom =
          (eD P Q).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (Subobject.ofLE (F.step (-Q)) (F.step (-(Q + 1)))
              (F.antitone_step (by omega))) (P + Q) ≫
            eqToHom (by rw [show P - 1 + (Q + 1) = P + Q by omega])) ∧
      (∀ P Q : ℤ,
        (filteredHomologyExactCouple K F).initialG P Q ≫
            eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega) ≫
            (filteredHomologyEIso K F (-Q) (P + 2 * Q)).hom ≫
            eqToHom (by
              rw [show -Q + (P + 2 * Q) = P + Q by omega]
              rfl) =
          (eD P Q).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (F.complexQuotientπ (-Q) (-Q + 1) (by omega)) (P + Q))
